summary: This standards-track document defines a new TLV for MPLS LSP Ping so it can check connectivity of Point-to-Multipoint pseudowires. LSP Ping is a widely used operations and maintenance tool in MPLS networks. The new TLV lets operators test these multi-receiver pseudowires with the same familiar tool.

eli5.summary: Ping checks if a friend can hear you. This adds a way to check that a message sent to many friends along a branching path really reaches each one.
